item.title: Attorney General Ellison to hold community forum on proposed acquisition of Allina Health by Sutter Health
item.description:
Publication Date: June 16, 2026

Forum to be held Monday, July 13 from 6:00-8:00 pm in Saint Paul: attendees and speakers asked to RSVP at links provided
